angle: Unlike other p-value materials that compute a statistic from a distribution, this one teaches thresholds and false positives purely through staged drug-trial stories that scale from anecdotes to repeat-experiment error rates.
angle_detail: Start with [05:35]–[08:51] because the same-drug repeat runs make the 0.05 cutoff and false-positive meaning concrete without any formula. Then watch [08:51]–[10:49] for the testing vocabulary and the warning that a small value says nothing about effect size. Note the gap: the closing numeric values arrive asserted rather than derived, so pair this with a video that computes a statistic when exam arithmetic is needed.
